title: Money and shopping
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a zsebpénzről, a spórolásról, a vásárlásról és a pénzügyeidről kérdez. Válaszolj több mondatban, és indokold a véleményedet.

questions.q: Do you get pocket money? What do you spend it on?
followUps: Do you think you get enough?

questions.q: Are you good at saving money? Are you saving for anything at the moment?
What was the last thing you bought for yourself?
Where do you usually go shopping for food and clothes?
Do you or your family buy things online? What?
followUps: What are the good and bad sides of online shopping?

questions.q: Who does the shopping in your family?
Do you prefer paying by card or in cash? Why?
What is expensive for teenagers in Hungary today?
If you got 100,000 forints as a present, what would you do with it?

usefulPhrases.en: I get ... forints a week / a month.
I'm saving up for a new phone.
I spend most of my money on ...
I pay by card most of the time.
I'd put it in the bank.
